*a man* is left added: rule 17 marks a supplied lexical subject noun added, and אֲשֶׁר already holds the *when* written for it. Reading *a man* as a supplied antecedent joining אֲשֶׁר under rule 46's first rider is the competing analysis.
s004 אֵת is the preposition H854 *with*, not the object marker; s033 אֶת is the marker rendered by the preposition through which *lighteth* reaches its object (rule 16, first family).
